source_name: FIPS 140-3 — Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules

The operator of a cryptographic module is responsible for ensuring that the security provided by a module is sufficient and acceptable to the owner of the information that is being protected and that any residual risk is acknowledged and accepted.
